**What would you like JARVIS to do?**
Clear description of the feature.

**Use case:**
When would you use this? What problem does it solve?

**Component:**
Which part of JARVIS would this affect? (STT, TTS, LLM, routing, tools, vision, memory, frontend)

**Hardware considerations:**
Would this increase VRAM usage, CPU load, or require additional hardware?

**Alternatives considered:**
Other approaches or workarounds you've tried.
